about.title: About Us
about.showeare: Ecomovil was born from a simple idea: make transportation more friendly with the environment, more affordable, and more sustainable. Founded by a group of college students in 2025, we've grown from a small project into a thriving community-driven marketplace.
about.whatareourmission: We're on a mission to revolutionize mobility by connecting people who want to buy, sell, or rent bikes, rollerskates, and skateboards. Whether you're a student, a professional, a tourist, or just someone looking for a greener way to get around — Ecomovil is for you. Together we're building a more sustainable future.
